name: Lazy Fade
author: Ben Dunkle

sections.description: Lazy Fade is a simple plugin to enhance the presentation of your site. As the user scrolls, content will slightly fade and animate into view, adding a more natural look and feel to the experience. Furthermore, images “below the fold” will only load when they come into view, saving download time and optimizing your site.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the lazy-fade folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Does this work with any theme?

Yes, it should work with any theme that uses standard WordPress image and group blocks.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

Fixed layout overflow issues by excluding alignfull group blocks from fade animation.

1.0.2

Fixed issue where elements at the bottom of the page wouldn’t fade in when scrolled into view.

1.0.1

Bug fixes
